name: PalPanelServerMods
description: Server-only Community-Raid build. Stable raid runtime, native wild-controller combat and the authoritative static arena remain enabled. The visible boundary uses UPalNPCManager::SpawnNPCForServer, the proven server-to-client path, with marker Pals continuously forced non-damageable, no-collision, movement-disabled and AI-suppressed. Marker level follows the raid level. PalNetworkTransmitter, direct Lua NetMulticast, BuildObject walls and SkillEffect barriers remain disabled. No client installation required.
